jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Houston, TX is seeking a Security Officer TWIC Access Driver for a full-time role. You will safeguard clients, monitor entry points, verify credentials, and maintain a professional environment across an industrial site.

A valid driver’s license and TSA TWIC are required, along with a high school diploma or equivalent. You will engage in incident response, routine patrols, and clear communication with supervisors and emergency responders as needed.

jobs.title: Day Shift Security Officer — Class A High-Rise, Full-Time
jobs.description:
United Protective Services is seeking a Day Shift Security Officer to safeguard a premier Class A high-rise in Houston. You will patrol interior and exterior areas, greet tenants and visitors, and enforce building policies with professionalism.

The role emphasizes strong customer service, attentiveness, and calm decision making during incidents. Shift schedule includes 8:00–16:00 hours on multiple days; reliable attendance is essential. Training is provided with opportunities for advancement.
